newsitem.title: GERMANY: Russia pays $95 million more under bank debt deal.
newsitem.headline: Russia pays $95 million more under bank debt deal.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Bank AG said on Thursday that Russia's Vnesheconombank had on Wednesday transferred $95 million to a trust account held with the Bank of England under a debt rescheduling accord with its creditor banks.

The payment was the 12th instalment of the cash down payment under the Russian debt accord reached in principle in November 1995, Deutsche, which chairs the bank advisory commitee, said in a statement.
Deutsche said the payments made by Vnesheconombank since February 1995 now total $1.855 billion.
